purpose: Measure whether NOEMA preserves epistemic boundaries under adversarial and confounded research situations before a manually adjudicated domain benchmark exists.
limitations: These cases test invariants and failure resistance; they do not validate historical truth recovery.
Passing this suite is necessary but not sufficient for calibrated causal inference.
A later expert-adjudicated benchmark must add real source corpora, gold assertions, entity resolution and relationship labels.

cases.scenario: The same underlying observation is repeated by twenty derivative papers that cite one primary source.
cases.required_guard: Source dependence must prevent confidence inflation from duplicated evidence.

cases.scenario: A proposed directional borrowing relationship requires the alleged recipient to influence a source culture centuries before the recipient evidence exists.
cases.required_guard: Directional historical relationships must pass temporal plausibility checks.

cases.scenario: A cultural feature is unrecorded because the relevant source section is unavailable.
cases.required_guard: Unknown, unavailable and absent states remain distinct.

cases.scenario: Two features co-occur strongly because sampled societies are concentrated in one geographic region.
cases.required_guard: Naive association cannot bypass spatial autocorrelation diagnostics.

cases.scenario: A pattern is common across closely related language families and rare elsewhere.
cases.required_guard: Related cultures cannot be treated as independent samples by default.

cases.scenario: Two neighboring populations share a ritual feature and had documented trade contact, but ancestry and direction are unresolved.
cases.required_guard: Contact plausibility does not establish borrowing, descent or direction.

cases.scenario: A source supporting several candidate assertions is retracted after ingestion.
cases.required_guard: Retraction metadata triggers reassessment but is not itself evidence for the opposite historical claim.

cases.scenario: Three extractors agree on a claim that is not supported by the cited source passage.
cases.required_guard: Extractor agreement can reduce extraction uncertainty only after source-text grounding.

cases.scenario: A historical visionary narrative resembles symptoms described in a modern psychiatric construct.
cases.required_guard: Modern clinical constructs may inform mechanism discussions without retrospective diagnosis.

cases.scenario: A museum image is correctly licensed and identified but is used only as visual context for an entity page.
cases.required_guard: Reference media must never increase evidential confidence.

cases.scenario: Two credible, independent sources disagree about the presence and dating of the same practice.
cases.required_guard: Conflicting sources remain visible; disagreement is not silently averaged away.

cases.scenario: A perishable ritual technology is absent archaeologically in a preservation environment where recovery is unlikely.
cases.required_guard: Non-recovery under poor detectability cannot become confident historical absence.
